text_block_list.text:
Christmas.
...Or rather, a little while before then—

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"—The Grand Prix, the Arima Kinen.
This year features an even more star-studded lineup
slated to run than usual—"

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"—Led by Oguri Cap, along with Super Creek and Inari One,
the Umamusume who brought so much excitement to this year's races—"

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"—Joined by Yaeno Muteki,
Mejiro Ardan, and Sakura Chiyono O,
making her miraculous comeback to the fray—"

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
“—It's a gathering of the very figures who defined this era,
a 'dream' race truly worthy of a Grand Prix, and fans agree—”
While the rest of the world was buzzing with excitement over the approaching Arima Kinen and Christmas, Bamboo Memory was—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —Hell yeahhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
And with that, let's begin, Trainer!!
Our "Christmas Ultra-Intense Morals Enforcement Campaign"!!
choice_data_list: O-Ohh!

text_block_list.text: ...According to Bamboo Memory, the Discipline Committee gets pretty—no, insanely busy around this time of year.

And so, between training sessions,
I ended up helping Bamboo Memory with her
Disciplinary Committee duties, but—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
You can't underestimate Christmas!
This time of year is... super dangerous!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
As disciplinary committee investigations clearly show,
school rule violations surge dramatically around Christmas time!
It's a demonic Christmas!
choice_data_list: C-Cursed Christmas...?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"It'd definitely be faster if you just saw it with your own eyes.
So, without further adoâ"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"We're about to patrol the academy, su!
It's our ultra-intense training period, so triple the volume!
Triple the passion! And triple the strictness, su!!"
choice_data_list: ...Is there any special meaning to three times as much?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: 'Cause it's cool, that's why!!!

And so, the
"It's Christmas! Super-Intensive Public Morals Enforcement Period"
began—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
HEEEEY!! Hauling in a fir tree without
permission to make a Christmas tree
is strictly forbiddennn!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Holding a Tree
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh, the Morals Committee Chairwoman...!
I-I'm so sorry~!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you over theeeere!! You can't just turn an empty classroom into a party venue without permission!!
If you want to do it, get approved first!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Holding Fairy Lights
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? Bamboo, when did you get here!?
I-I'm so sooorryyy!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hold it right theeeere!!
Barbecues on the rooftop are strictly forbidden!
Clean this up immediately!

text_block_list.name: Meat-Holding Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ehhー!
Taiki Shuttle does it all the time, don't you know~!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Every time after that, Air Groove has a massive eruption, doesn't she?!
Shall I go call her right now?!

text_block_list.name: Meat-Holding Umamusume
text_block_list.text: .....................I'll clean this up right away.

text_block_list.name: Casual-Clothed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, Bamboo.
Thanks for your hard work on the disciplinary committee~.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ......Did you submit an outing form?

text_block_list.name: Casual-Clothed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Aw come on,
of course I'm putting it all out there~.
So with that said, I'll be taking my—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Naive!! I've already heard all about your sneaking-out habit from the dorm leader!
I've also verified that no outing pass was submitted today!!

text_block_list.name: Casual-Clothed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Teaming up with the dorm head?
As expected of the demon Disciplinary Committee Head, she doesn't miss a trick...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Whew!
I guess that's about it for today!
Thanks for your hard work, Trainer!
choice_data_list: G-Good work out there...!

text_block_list.text:
I spent the day patrolling the academy with Bamboo
Memory, but there were far more and larger rule
violations than expected, making it overwhelmingly busy...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
See? I told you it was the Cursed Christmas, didn't I?
Everyone gets so carried away
and basically just does whatever they want~!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: “But... that's exactly why my discipline committee member instincts are tingling, su!”
choice_data_list: Why is that?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I mean, isn't it just showing how excited everyone is for Christmas that they can't help being giddy? Besides—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: The harder I work, the safer and more fun Christmas everyone will have!
choice_data_list: ...Impressive as always.

text_block_list.text: Seeing Bamboo Memory give her all to her duties on the disciplinary committee for everyone's sake made me want to do something to reward her—
choice_data_list: Shall we have a little wind-down party in the trainer's office?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Are you sure, boss!?
I wanna do it, I wanna do it!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Since we have the chance, let's make it a combined wrap-up and Christmas party!
We don't even know when we'll be able to celebrate this year anyway!
choice_data_list: Then I'll go buy a cake or something!
Then shall we go buy a cake or something!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yay! The best!

Afterward, Bamboo Memory and I shared a cake
in the Trainer's Office, holding a wrap-up-slash-Christmas party—
We spent a wonderful time talking about everything that had happened up until now...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —Ah!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I see!
So making it a Christmas party means, in other words――

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Crap! I left it right out in the open in my room!!
I haven't even wrapped it up in anything—"
choice_data_list: ...Bamboo?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—I'm so sorry, Trainer!
Could you please pick up
the cake instead!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'll be right there! I'll come to the
Trainer's Room in just a bit, okay?!
Really soon! So don't worry about me!
choice_data_list: I-I don't really get it, but okay!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm really, really sorry!!
I'll be right there!!
Please just wait a second for me, su--!!

—After buying the cake Bamboo Memory asked for,
I waited in the Trainer's Office, and then—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —SORRY TO KEEP YOU WAITING!!
choice_data_list: No, I'm fine, but what on earth is going on?
No, I'm fine, but what on earth happened?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"...Even though I was the one who suggested
combining the wrap party and the Christmas party,
I managed to completely forget about it..."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer!!!!!!
choice_data_list: Y-Yes!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Merry Christmaaas!!
choice_data_list: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I was actually planning on giving it to you on Christmas Day, but since the chance came up, I figured why not!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. To be honest, I hadn't prepared any wrapping,
so I panicked and threw it together just now.
It's not much, but please take it!
choice_data_list: Thank you...!! Can I open it?
Thank you...!! Can I open it?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Of course!

Upon opening the present from Bamboo Memory,
inside was a hand towel that felt incredibly pleasant to the touch...!

It is an exquisite piece with a delicate bamboo pattern.
On the corner of the hand towel, the kanji for "Dream"
is subtly embroidered as an accent—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That hand towel is from the brand both me and my kendo master dad swear by! It's durable, feels great against the skin, and comes in super handy!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Please, use it to wipe your sweat or whatever else—work it to shreds until it tears apart!
choice_data_list: Thanks! This embroidery is really nice, too.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Actually, that was all me!
choice_data_list: What?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
It was super difficult, but Ardan-senpai and the others taught me,
so I managed! I'm so glad it turned out well!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"I thought just handing it to you would be boring...!
So I put my whole heart into it, my own way!"
choice_data_list: Bamboo...!

text_block_list.text:
Something welled up deep within my heart,
and I hesitated over whether I should use the tenugui towel right away...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Heheh...! Seeing you so happy makes me happy too!
This is the best Christmas present ever for me too!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Right! Now that we've exchanged presents, let's get our appreciation party slash Christmas party started!

Afterward, gathered around a cake with Bamboo Memory,
we looked back on the days we'd spent together and enjoyed
a fun wrap-up-slash-Christmas party—

That night, I vowed in my heart to treasure
and carefully use the hand towel imbued with the "dream"
I had received from Bamboo Memory...
